svg.title: Obsidian Plugin Creator: choose an idea, forge a plugin
svg.desc: A pixel vault keeper chooses an idea and sends it into a floating amethyst crystal. Orbiting notes carry knowledge, modules ease into place, a finished plugin capsule lifts from the workbench, and the keeper celebrates. A smooth twelve second conceptual loop, not a product demonstration.
svg.text: A second brain for your next plugin.
Good ideas. Connected knowledge. Useful tools.
